RSS Feed Add to Google Major government and freight data reshape industrial demand KBR (KBR) won an $8 billion Antarctic science and engineering support contract, a large backlog add that improves visibility for its mission‑technology unit and lifts the government‑services margin outlook. Oshkosh Defense (OSK) secured $142 million in FMTV A2 orders, reinforcing production cadence for military vehicle suppliers and aftermarket parts flows. RTX (RTX) unit Raytheon won a $515 million award for the SPY‑6 radar family, a program‑level win that helps sustain long‑cycle avionics revenue for primes. XPO (XPO) published North American LTL operating data for May, offering an early read on freight volumes and pricing trends investors use to gauge cyclicality in logistics and carrier margins. Energy transition and critical minerals: policy, capacity and deals USA Rare Earth (USAR) finalized agreements with the U.S. Department of Commerce unlocking access to up to $1.6 billion to develop a domestic rare‑earth value chain—a notable industrial‑policy step for magnets and EV motors. TransAlta (TAC) agreed to acquire two fully‑contracted gas assets in Colorado and launched a concurrent $350 million bought‑deal offering. The move blends regulated‑style cash flow with capital markets support and reshapes the company's near‑term financing mix. Air Products (APD) held a ribbon‑cutting for a $70 million expansion of its membrane manufacturing center—capacity that supports hydrogen and gas processing supply chains. Medtech and digital‑health results that shift procedure and consumables outlooks Medtronic (MDT) reported fiscal 2026 results showing its strongest annual revenue growth in a decade and flagged strategic investments in cardiac ablation that could lift procedure volumes and higher‑margin device sales over time. MiniMed (MMED) posted robust FY2026 results, issued FY2027 guidance and unveiled a sensor partnership with Abbott—heightening competition in automated insulin delivery. Insulet (PODD) began a U.S. rollout of an enhanced Omnipod® 5 algorithm, broadening sensor compatibility and potentially accelerating adoption and reimbursement discussions. Biotech and pharma: regulatory milestones, collaborations and pivotal trial readouts Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) posted late‑breaking Phase 2 data where nipocalimab reduced SLE activity, a signal that could strengthen its immunology franchise if replicated in larger trials. ADC Therapeutics (ADCT) released LOTIS‑5 Phase 3 results for ZYNLONTA® plus rituximab, an outcome that will guide labeling, market sizing and near‑term commercial expectations. Iovance (IOVA) received approval in Australia for Amtagvi® (lifileucel), adding an international commercial footprint for cell‑therapy revenues. Alnylam (ALNY) formed a strategic AI collaboration with Inceptive to accelerate RNAi therapeutic discovery, a development that could shorten preclinical timelines and influence R&D productivity expectations. Read the announcement here. Darling Ingredients (DAR)'s health brand Rousselot received a U.S. patent for Nextida® GC, described as the first collagen peptide composition supporting blood‑glucose regulation—an IP milestone that could expand consumer‑health avenues for ingredient licensing. Software, cloud and cybersecurity earnings move market sentiment on AI adoption Netskope (NTSK) reported strong fiscal Q1 results, reinforcing enterprise demand for cloud security and data‑centric AI controls—metrics investors watch for recurring revenue growth. CrowdStrike (CRWD) released first‑quarter FY2027 results that continue to highlight subscription momentum in endpoint and identity security. CXAI (CXAI) acquired EngineRoom to triple annualized revenue run‑rate and accelerate commercialization of its agentic AI SKY platform—a deal that will be watched for integration execution and revenue cadence.
